gita_evidence.sanskrit: कर्मण्य् एवाधिकारस् ते मा फलेषु कदाचन | मा कर्म-फल-हेतुर् भूर् मा ते सङ्गो ऽस्त्व् अकर्मणि
gita_evidence.transliteration: karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana | mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stv akarmaṇi
gita_evidence.translation: You have the right to act, never to the fruits of action. Never let the fruit be your motive, and never let inaction be your refuge.

gita_evidence.sanskrit: सुख-दुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ | ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापम् अवाप्स्यसि
gita_evidence.transliteration: sukha-duḥkhe same kṛtvā lābhālābhau jayājayau | tato yuddhāya yujyasva naivaṃ pāpam avāpsyasi
gita_evidence.translation: Hold pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat as equal, then take up the fight. Acting that way, you will not incur sin.

gita_evidence.sanskrit: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनंजय | सिद्ध्य्-असिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते
gita_evidence.transliteration: yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dhanaṃjaya | siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṃ yoga ucyate
gita_evidence.translation: Stand firm in yoga, act without clinging to outcomes, Arjuna, and meet success and failure with the same mind. That evenness of spirit is what yoga means.
